watchOS 27.2 is expected to launch next month, bringing multiple new features to Apple Watch, and leaker pdfu has also discovered a major change to the screenshot functionality.

The new screenshot experience in the watchOS 27.2 code references the iPhone design

Leaker pdfu has recently continued to share various details unearthed from Apple's code. For example, he was the first to discover the watchOS 27 "Readiness" app, and yesterday he was also the first to reveal the HomePod's Siri AI interface.

In a new article published today, pdfu revealed that the watchOS 27.2 beta contains code related to a redesigned screenshot experience for Apple Watch.

Currently, when you take a screenshot on Apple Watch, the screen simply flashes briefly, and the screenshot is immediately saved to your Photos library.

The new screenshot process follows the current approach used on iPhone and iPad, allowing you to instantly choose to share or delete the screenshot.

It is still unclear which watchOS 27.2 beta Apple plans to include this change in, nor whether more development time is required. However, even if it ultimately misses the watchOS 27.2 release, this feature is very likely to arrive on Apple Watch in the near future.

What do you think of the new screenshot experience leaked for watchOS 27.2? Let us know in the comments.
